[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    { include-group = "tests" },
    { include-group = "docs" },
    { include-group = "translations" },
    "playwright >=1.57.0",
    "prek >=0.2.22",
    "zizmor >=1.32.0",
]
docs = [
    { include-group = "docs-tests" },
    "black >=25.1.0",
    "cairosvg >=2.8.2",
    "griffe-typingdoc >=0.3.0",
    "griffe-warnings-deprecated >=1.1.0",
    "jieba >=0.42.1",
    "markdown-include-variants >=0.0.10",
    "mdx-include >=1.4.1,<2.0.0",
    "mkdocstrings[python] >=1.0.3",
    "pillow >=11.3.0",
    "pyyaml >=5.3.1,<7.0.0",
    "typer >=0.21.1",
    "zensical >=0.0.42",
]
docs-tests = [
    "httpx >=0.23.0,<1.0.0",
    "httpx2>=2.0.0",
    "python-slugify >=8.0.4",
    "ruff>=0.14.14,<0.17.0",
]
github-actions = [
    "httpx >=0.27.0,<1.0.0",
    "pydantic >=2.9.0,<3.0.0",
    "pydantic-settings >=2.1.0,<3.0.0",
    "pygithub >=2.3.0,<3.0.0",
    "pyyaml >=5.3.1,<7.0.0",
    "smokeshow >=0.5.0",
]
tests = [
    "opentelemetry-instrumentation-fastapi>=0.65b0",
    "logfire>=5.1.0",
    "sentry-sdk>=2.70.0",
    "opentelemetry-sdk>=1.44.0",
    "opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-http>=1.44.0",

    { include-group = "docs-tests" },
    "anyio[trio] >=4.1.0,<5.0.0",
    "coverage[toml] >=7.13,<8.0",
    "dirty-equals >=0.9.0",
    "flask >=3.0.0,<4.0.0",
    "inline-snapshot >=0.21.1",
    "mypy >=1.14.1",
    "pwdlib[argon2] >=0.2.1",
    "pyjwt >=2.9.0",
    # Remove this cap after requiring a pytest-xdist release with the fix for
    # pytest >=9.2 loadgroup compatibility: https://github.com/pytest-dev/pytest-xdist/pull/1388
    "pytest >=9.0.0,<9.2",
    "pytest-codspeed >=4.3.0",
    "pyyaml >=5.3.1,<7.0.0",
    "sqlmodel >=0.0.31",
    "strawberry-graphql >=0.200.0,<1.0.0",
    "ty>=0.0.25",
    "typer >=0.26.1",
    "a2wsgi >=1.9.0,<=2.0.0",
    "pytest-xdist[psutil]>=3.0.2",
    "pytest-cov>=4.0.0",
    "pytest-sugar>=1.0.0",
    "pytest-timeout>=2.4.0",
]
translations = [
    "gitpython >=3.1.46",
    "pydantic-ai-slim[openai] >=2.0.0",
    "pygithub >=2.8.1",
]

[tool.pdm]
version = { source = "file", path = "fastapi/__init__.py" }
distribution = true

[tool.pdm.build]
source-includes = [
    "tests/",
    "docs_src/",
    "scripts/",
    # For a test
    "docs/en/docs/img/favicon.png",
]

[tool.mypy]
plugins = ["pydantic.mypy"]
strict = true

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
module = "fastapi.concurrency"
warn_unused_ignores = false
ignore_missing_imports = true

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
module = "fastapi.tests.*"
ignore_missing_imports = true
check_untyped_defs = true

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
module = "docs_src.*"
disallow_incomplete_defs = false
disallow_untyped_defs = false
disallow_untyped_calls = false

[tool.pytest]
minversion = "9.0"
addopts = [
  "--strict-config",
  "--strict-markers",
  "--ignore=docs_src",
]
strict_xfail = true
filterwarnings = [
    "error",
]
timeout = "20"

[tool.coverage.run]
# Dynamic test contexts require the C tracer.
core = "ctrace"
patch = ["subprocess", "_exit"]
parallel = true
data_file = "coverage/.coverage"
source = [
    "docs_src",
    "tests",
    "fastapi"
]
relative_files = true
context = '${CONTEXT}'
omit = [
    "tests/benchmarks/*",
    "tests/memory_benchmarks/*",
    "docs_src/response_model/tutorial003_04.py",
    "docs_src/dependencies/tutorial013.py",  # temporary code example?
    "docs_src/dependencies/tutorial014.py",  # temporary code example?
    # Pydantic v1 migration, no longer tested
    "docs_src/pydantic_v1_in_v2/tutorial001.py",
    "docs_src/pydantic_v1_in_v2/tutorial002.py",
    "docs_src/pydantic_v1_in_v2/tutorial003.py",
    "docs_src/pydantic_v1_in_v2/tutorial004.py",
]

[tool.coverage.report]
show_missing = true
sort = "-Cover"

[tool.coverage.html]
show_contexts = true

[tool.ruff]
# Translation fixtures intentionally contain malformed code and comments.
extend-exclude = ["scripts/tests/test_translation_fixer/**/*.md"]

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = [
    "E",  # pycodestyle errors
    "W",  # pycodestyle warnings
    "F",  # pyflakes
    "I",  # isort
    "B",  # flake8-bugbear
    "C4",  # flake8-comprehensions
    "UP",  # pyupgrade
]
ignore = [
    "E501",  # line too long, handled by black
    "B008",  # do not perform function calls in argument defaults
    "C901",  # too complex
]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
"__init__.py" = ["F401"]
"docs_src/custom_request_and_route/tutorial002.py" = ["B904"]
"docs_src/custom_request_and_route/tutorial002_non_an.py" = ["B904"]
"docs_src/custom_response/tutorial007.py" = ["B007"]
"docs_src/dependencies/tutorial007.py" = ["F821"]
"docs_src/dependencies/tutorial008.py" = ["F821"]
"docs_src/dependencies/tutorial008_non_an.py" = ["F821"]
"docs_src/dependencies/tutorial008b.py" = ["B904"]
"docs_src/dependencies/tutorial008b_non_an.py" = ["B904"]
"docs_src/dependencies/tutorial010.py" = ["F821"]
"docs_src/path_operation_advanced_configuration/tutorial007.py" = ["B904"]
"docs_src/query_params_str_validations/tutorial012.py" = ["B006"]
"docs_src/query_params_str_validations/tutorial013.py" = ["B006"]
"docs_src/security/tutorial004.py" = ["B904"]
"docs_src/security/tutorial004_non_an.py" = ["B904"]
"docs_src/security/tutorial005.py" = ["B904"]
"docs_src/security/tutorial005_non_an.py" = ["B904"]
"docs_src/json_base64_bytes/tutorial001.py" = ["UP012"]
"docs_src/stream_json_lines/tutorial001.py" = ["UP028"]
"docs_src/stream_data/tutorial001.py" = ["UP028"]
"docs_src/stream_data/tutorial002.py" = ["UP028"]
"docs_src/server_sent_events/tutorial001.py" = ["UP028"]
# These regression tests intentionally use str/Enum.
"tests/test_no_schema_split.py" = ["UP042"]
"tests/test_schema_compat_pydantic_v2.py" = ["UP042"]

[tool.ruff.lint.isort]
known-third-party = ["fastapi", "pydantic", "starlette"]

[tool.ruff.lint.pyupgrade]
# Preserve types, even if a file imports `from __future__ import annotations`.
keep-runtime-typing = true

[tool.inline-snapshot]
# default-flags=["fix"]
# default-flags=["create"]

[tool.typos.files]
extend-exclude = [
    "coverage/",
    "dist/",
    "docs/de/",
    "docs/en/data/",
    "docs/en/docs/img/",
    "docs/es/",
    "docs/fr/",
    "docs/ja/",
    "docs/ko/",
    "docs/language_names.yml",
    "docs/pt/",
    "docs/ru/",
    "docs/tr/",
    "docs/uk/",
    "docs/zh/",
    "docs/zh-hant/",
    "docs/hi/",
    "htmlcov/",
    "scripts/general-llm-prompt.md",
    "scripts/tests/test_translation_fixer/test_complex_doc/",
    "site/",
    "site_build/",
    "uv.lock",
]

[tool.typos.default]
extend-ignore-re = [
    # GitHub usernames in @mentions
    "@[a-zA-Z0-9](?:-?[a-zA-Z0-9])*",
    # Quoted typo documented in a release note
    "'wll' to 'will'",
    # German article title in a release note
    "FastAPI Modul.",
]

[tool.typos.default.extend-identifiers]
alls = "alls"

[tool.typos.default.extend-words]
ba = "ba"
certifi = "certifi"
fo = "fo"
havin = "havin"
Ines = "Ines"
ser = "ser"

[tool.ty.src]
exclude = [
    # These docs examples are intentionally partial, dynamic, environment-driven,
    # deprecated, or currently require broader tutorial rewrites to satisfy ty.
    "docs_src/additional_status_codes/",
    "docs_src/app_testing/tutorial003.py",
    "docs_src/body_multiple_params/",
    "docs_src/body_updates/tutorial002.py",
    "docs_src/custom_docs_ui/",
    "docs_src/custom_response/tutorial001.py",
    "docs_src/custom_response/tutorial001b.py",
    "docs_src/custom_response/tutorial009c.py",
    "docs_src/dependencies/tutorial007.py",
    "docs_src/dependencies/tutorial008.py",
    "docs_src/dependencies/tutorial008_non_an.py",
    "docs_src/dependencies/tutorial010.py",
    "docs_src/events/",
    "docs_src/extending_openapi/tutorial001.py",
    "docs_src/path_params_numeric_validations/",
    "docs_src/pydantic_v1_in_v2/tutorial004.py",
    "docs_src/python_types/tutorial003.py",
    "docs_src/python_types/tutorial011.py",
    "docs_src/query_params_str_validations/",
    "docs_src/response_model/tutorial006.py",
    "docs_src/security/tutorial003.py",
    "docs_src/security/tutorial003_non_an.py",
    "docs_src/security/tutorial004.py",
    "docs_src/security/tutorial004_non_an.py",
    "docs_src/security/tutorial005.py",
    "docs_src/security/tutorial005_non_an.py",
    "docs_src/settings/",
    "docs_src/sql_databases/",
    "docs_src/using_request_directly/tutorial001.py",
    "docs_src/wsgi/tutorial001.py",
]

[tool.ty.terminal]
error-on-warning = true
